caption: Eggs boil in a pot on a stove, rattling against each other as the water bubbles around them.

sa.check: A pot of water sits on a hob.
The eggs jostle against each other.
The eggs stay at the pot's bottom.

pc.expect: The eggs move only as the bubbling water pushes them: they knock and shift while the water churns and settle when it calms.
pc.fail: An egg darts across the pot with the water still; or an egg spins fast on the spot with nothing turning it; or the eggs jostle in water with no bubbles rising; or an egg jumps out of the water.

pc.expect: The boil keeps up while the eggs knock: bubbles keep arriving from below and steam keeps leaving.
pc.fail: The bubbling stops and then starts again by itself; or the steam runs back into the pot; or bubbles sink from the surface to the eggs; or the surface goes glassy still while bubbles stream below it.

pc.expect: The eggs rest low in the pot and the bubbles and steam rise.
pc.fail: An egg rises out of the water and hangs above it; or an egg hangs motionless in mid-water; or bubbles sink toward the pot's floor; or the steam sinks and pools around the pot.

pc.expect: The eggs are hard-shelled solids that knock and rebound off each other and the pot, and the water closes round them.
pc.fail: An egg squashes where it strikes another; or an egg's shell bends; or the eggs merge into one lump; or the water holds a dent around an egg like a solid.

pc.expect: The eggs keep their number and stay in the pot; nothing appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: An egg vanishes; or a new egg appears; or an egg passes through the pot's wall; or two eggs merge into one.

pc.expect: The pot, the hob and the eggs' shells stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or an egg's shell changes colour; or the hob's knobs move by themselves.

note: The rattle is sound and is not judged; the jostling is read from the eggs' visible knocking.
